title: GitHub Repository Creation
description: Request creation of a new GitHub repository

elements.name: sla_info
elements.html:
SLA:

GitHub repository creation typically takes 2-3 business days for standard repositories. Repositories requiring special permissions or organizational setup may take up to 5 business days.

elements.name: important_notes
elements.html:
Important Notes:
  • Repository names must be unique within the organization
  • Use a descriptive name that clearly identifies the repository's purpose
  • Specify the appropriate visibility level - private repositories require justification
  • Consider whether you need branch protection rules or special permissions
  • You'll receive access credentials and repository URL via email once created
  • If you need a template repository, specify it in the description
